status: exact coefficient-PF, multiplier-sequence, and Jensen-window equivalence gate
proof_boundary: This artifact proves an equivalence between all-order target formulations and guards against finite, signed-Hankel-only, and positive-mixture promotions. It does not prove coefficient PF-infinity for the zeta coefficients, the missing signed-Hankel-to-PF bridge, Laguerre-Polya membership, RH, or Lambda <= 0.

exact.scope_assumptions: A_k>=0 for every k, A_0>0, and F is entire; all hold for the corpus zeta coefficient sequence
exact.polya_schur: {A_k} is a multiplier sequence <=> F is Laguerre-Polya type I <=> P_(d,0) is hyperbolic for every d
exact.derivative_closure: F in Laguerre-Polya type I => F^(n) in Laguerre-Polya type I for every n
exact.finite_asw: P_(d,n) has only real nonpositive zeros <=> B^(d,n)_j=C(d,j)*A_(n+j) is a finite PF-infinity sequence
exact.equivalence: c is PF-infinity <=> F is Laguerre-Polya type I <=> A is a multiplier sequence <=> every P_(d,0) is hyperbolic <=> every shifted A_(n+j) is a multiplier sequence <=> every P_(d,n) is hyperbolic <=> every B^(d,n) is finite PF-infinity
exact.finite_guard: finite Toeplitz/PF certificates for c do not imply c is PF-infinity
exact.signed_hankel_guard: signed-Hankel positivity does not by itself imply coefficient PF-infinity or the equivalent Jensen-window target
exact.positive_mixture_guard: a positive mixture of dilations is coefficient-positive but is a hyperbolicity preserver only after a separate multiplier-sequence theorem

rows.claim: The ordinary coefficient generating function is exactly the exponential generating function of A.
Every Jensen window is the image of a binomial power under the diagonal tail operator.
Polya-Schur identifies shift-zero Jensen hyperbolicity in every degree with the multiplier-sequence property of A.
rows.formula: {A_k} is a multiplier sequence <=> F is Laguerre-Polya type I <=> P_(d,0) is hyperbolic for every d
rows.proof_boundary: Classical equivalence; it does not prove its hypothesis for the zeta coefficients.

rows.claim: For the entire positive generating function F, ASW/Edrei identifies coefficient PF-infinity with the type-I product form.
rows.proof_boundary: Classical characterization; all-order Toeplitz positivity remains unproved here.

rows.claim: The exponential generating function of every shifted A-tail is the corresponding derivative of F.
rows.proof_boundary: Formal differentiation identity, justified by the known entire convergence of F.

rows.claim: Laguerre-Polya type I is closed under differentiation, so a shift-zero multiplier theorem supplies every shifted tail.
rows.formula: F in Laguerre-Polya type I => F^(n) in Laguerre-Polya type I for every n
rows.proof_boundary: Classical closure step conditional on the unproved type-I membership of F.

rows.claim: Combining Polya-Schur with derivative closure proves all-degree/all-shift Jensen hyperbolicity from coefficient PF-infinity.
rows.formula: c PF-infinity => F type I => every F^(n) type I => every P_(d,n) hyperbolic
rows.proof_boundary: Exact conditional composition; the first all-order antecedent is still open.

rows.claim: For each fixed finite window, hyperbolicity and finite PF-infinity are equivalent.
rows.formula: P_(d,n) has only real nonpositive zeros <=> B^(d,n)_j=C(d,j)*A_(n+j) is a finite PF-infinity sequence

rows.claim: The all-order coefficient-PF and all-degree/all-shift Jensen-window targets are exact reformulations of one endpoint theorem.
rows.formula: c is PF-infinity <=> F is Laguerre-Polya type I <=> A is a multiplier sequence <=> every P_(d,0) is hyperbolic <=> every shifted A_(n+j) is a multiplier sequence <=> every P_(d,n) is hyperbolic <=> every B^(d,n) is finite PF-infinity
rows.proof_boundary: Equivalence of targets, not a proof that any target statement holds for zeta.

rows.claim: The existing finite coefficient-PF ledger cannot enter the all-order equivalence.
rows.formula: finite Toeplitz/PF certificates for c do not imply c is PF-infinity
rows.proof_boundary: Blocks promotion of finite Toeplitz evidence only.

rows.claim: The equivalence does not create the missing transfer from signed-Hankel data to coefficient PF-infinity.
rows.formula: signed-Hankel positivity does not by itself imply coefficient PF-infinity or the equivalent Jensen-window target
rows.proof_boundary: Preserves the central structural gap and its existing countermodels.

rows.claim: Positivity of the Phi moment integral or a mixture-of-dilations formula is not itself a real-rootedness preserver theorem.
rows.formula: a positive mixture of dilations is coefficient-positive but is a hyperbolicity preserver only after a separate multiplier-sequence theorem
rows.proof_boundary: Requires an independent multiplier or stability-preserver hypothesis; positivity alone is insufficient.

rows.claim: The live task is one noncircular all-order proof of coefficient PF-infinity, equivalently of the Jensen-window target, from Xi/Phi-specific structure.
rows.formula: Xi/Phi-specific structure => c PF-infinity <=> all Jensen windows PF-infinity
rows.proof_boundary: Open structural theorem; not PF-infinity, Laguerre-Polya membership, RH, or Lambda <= 0.
